{{Short description|Czech nuclear physicist and university rector}}
[[File:Ivan Wilhelm P6117657.jpg|thumb|upright|Ivan Wilhelm in June 2011]]
'''Ivan Wilhelm''' (1 May 1942, [[Trnava]]) is a [[Czech Republic|Czech]] nuclear physicist and former [[Rector (academia)|rector]] of the [[Charles University in Prague]].<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.lidovky.cz/byvaly-rektor-uk-chce-do-europarlamentu-f0y-/ln_eu.asp?c=A090304_171745_ln_eu_mel|title=Bývalý rektor UK chce do europarlamentu|date=2009-03-04|publisher=[[Lidové noviny]]|language=Czech|accessdate=20 April 2010}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.bbc.co.uk/czech/interview/story/2005/06/050603_wilhelm.shtml|title=Ivan Wilhelm (interview)|last=Moravec|first=Václav|date=2005-07-07|publisher=BBC Czech|language=Czech|accessdate=20 April 2010}}</ref>

Wilhelm graduated from the Faculty of Nuclear Sciences and Physical Engineering of [[Czech Technical University in Prague]] with a degree in nuclear physics. Until 1967, he also lectured there. In 1967, Wilhelm was sent to study in the United States. Since 1971, Wilhelm has been a part of the Faculty of Mathematics and Physics of [[Charles University in Prague]].
